palette_rationale: Exactly64 approved Idle v2 colors including both source dark-eye blues. Fixed source-nearest palette before packing; no per-sheet quantization/dithering/newcolors.
reference: Seel PMDO Sprite0086: flipper/belly body archetype for timing/hold only where native semantics absent; no face/pose transfer.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Source alternating flipper paddle with belly bob and lagging tail/crest. Engine owns logical travel; native centerXZ stabilized, Y retained.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Source rear-up, tucked flippers and forward open-mouth body/flipper thrust; .4s anticipation and .7s contact chosen from side audition. ba01 deep downward flipper stab rejected for ground incompatibility; no alpha crop.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Source open-mouth rear-up/release and recovery. Native bs01 resembles ba02 body thrust but begins with mouth open; emphasis on mouth release/hold. No projectile asset or verified discharge claimed; Seel Shoot hold convention only.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native lowered head/resting flippers and slow body/tail breathing. Authored b01 second-row closed-eye curves selected explicitly at UV3V+.25 with crop mask; not inferred/exported facial clip, no raster lid.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native backward head/chest recoil, braced flippers and tail bend, recovering to upright. Source pose only; ground-color overlap must be audited.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native paired flippers fold/cross at chest then sweep outward, mouth opening and tail counterpose. Body-appropriate flipper sweep, not human arm attack. Retimed pose evidence from front/side auditions.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two retimed native rear-up/thrust cycles, visible contacts3 and9. Only first contact is engine HitFrame; no invented additional gameplay damage.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native bd02 launch has a clear airborne arc but later falls onto back. Use only first upright launch poses, then reverse them to land upright. Explicit mirrored native-pose retiming, not a native standalone jump. Seel Hop landing/airtime convention; no synthetic vertical displacement.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native upright belly/chest rise with tucked/crossed flippers and crest/tail motion, then release. Interpreted gathering tension; pinned Seel Charge buildup/hold convention, no energy effect.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: No native complete grounded yaw turn found: add explicit whole-body360deg yaw through canonical camera azimuth to native fq02 head look/tail gesture. Full upright turn, fixed scale/origin and source occlusion; native bv01 is a flipper celebration, not a spin.
